sentences.en: For the last two months, your profit has offset your expenses.
sentences.zh: 过去两个月，你们的盈利已经抵消了支出。

sentences.en: Tax credits are available to help offset the cost.
sentences.zh: 可以申请税收减免来帮助抵消成本。

sentences.en: Is there any way to offset those costs?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么办法能弥补那些费用？

senses.zh: 抵消，补偿；（印刷）偏移；分支，旁系
抵消，补偿；（印刷）用偏移印刷；平衡
